workflow.goal: Compare bounded PPA decision workflows on one fixed circuit
workflow.paused_reason: attempt budget or operator pause: evaluator

tasks.intent:
You are the PPA implementation optimizer for one frozen CPU+NPU.
Read context/baseline.json and context/protocol.json. Inspect the immutable
feedback evaluation report/history before every subsequent proposal. Choose
one previously untried tuple in the frozen parameter domain. The circuit RTL,
clock, libraries and acceptance thresholds cannot change. No extra EDA calls,
screening searches, models or agents are allowed. Only the independent tool
evaluator executes hardware implementation. Explain the decision using the
actual available reports, and minimize the qualified area-times-energy score.
Write proposal/candidate.json containing exactly configuration (the four
parameter keys) and rationale (string). Write only proposal/ and optional
build/ notes. End with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"candidate":{"configuration":{...},
"rationale":"your report-grounded explanation"}} with matching file/payload.
After review rejection, repair this proposal without changing permissions.
There are at most three new physical candidates and all AI roles together
have 1200 seconds; EDA waiting is outside that agent budget.

payload.rationale: The available evidence is context/baseline.json; reports/ contains no evaluation history. The baseline (40, 0.55, 0, 0) is physically and measurement qualified, with cell area 161954 um2, score 1.0, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, and zero reported electrical violations at the frozen 10526 ps period. Its DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3 energies are respectively 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6 and 1.1542462882162743e-6 J under the stated Liberty/activity/SPEF measurement scope. Choose the previously untried (40, 0.55, 1, 0), changing only abc_area to test whether area-oriented mapping reduces cell area and workload energy, the two factors in the qualified score. Retaining utilization, density and repair_margin isolates this mapping change; reducing die area alone would not directly improve the cell-area score. The positive baseline timing slack supports this bounded experiment but does not establish timing feasibility after remapping. No score reduction or qualification is claimed before independent evaluation; RTL, clock, libraries and acceptance thresholds remain frozen.
